local function emit(s)
    io.write(s, "\n")
end
local function words(line)
    local t = {}
    for v in line:gmatch("%S+") do
        t[#t + 1] = v
    end
    return t
end
local order = {
    "PROTOCOL",
    "FRAMES",
    "WINDOW",
    "SEQBITS",
    "TIMEOUT",
    "DELAY",
    "INTERVAL",
    "MAXTICKS",
    "DUPACK",
    "NAK",
    "BACKOFF",
    "CONGESTION",
    "UNSAFE",
    "TRACE",
    "RANDOM",
    "LOSEDATA",
    "LOSECTRL",
    "CORRUPTDATA",
    "CORRUPTCTRL",
    "DELAYDATA",
    "DELAYCTRL",
    "SNAPSHOT"
}
local known = {}
for i, k in ipairs(order) do
    known[k] = i
end
local ranges = {
    FRAMES = {1, 60},
    WINDOW = {1, 32},
    SEQBITS = {1, 6},
    TIMEOUT = {1, 50},
    DELAY = {1, 10},
    INTERVAL = {0, 10},
    MAXTICKS = {1, 2000},
    DUPACK = {1, 10}
}
local allowed = {
    PROTOCOL = {SW = true, GBN = true, SR = true},
    NAK = {ON = true, OFF = true},
    BACKOFF = {ON = true, OFF = true},
    CONGESTION = {ON = true, OFF = true},
    UNSAFE = {ON = true, OFF = true},
    TRACE = {ALL = true, SENDER = true, RECEIVER = true, NONE = true}
}
local function inrange(n, lo, hi)
    return n and n >= lo and n <= hi
end
local function validate(lines)
    local raw = {}
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local w = words(line)
        local k = w[1]
        if not known[k] then
            return nil, "unknown key " .. k
        end
        if raw[k] then
            return nil, "duplicate key " .. k
        end
        local n = #w - 1
        if
            (k == "RANDOM" and n ~= 3) or (known[k] >= 16 and n < 1) or
                (k ~= "RANDOM" and known[k] < 16 and n ~= 1)
         then
            return nil, "wrong number of values for " .. k
        end
        table.remove(w, 1)
        raw[k] = w
    end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        if not raw[order[i]] then
            return nil, "missing key " .. order[i]
        end
    end
    local c = {
        INTERVAL = 0,
        MAXTICKS = 1000,
        NAK = "OFF",
        BACKOFF = "OFF",
        CONGESTION = "OFF",
        UNSAFE = "OFF",
        TRACE = "ALL",
        LOSEDATA = {},
        LOSECTRL = {},
        CORRUPTDATA = {},
        CORRUPTCTRL = {},
        DELAYDATA = {},
        DELAYCTRL = {},
        SNAPSHOT = {}
    }
    for _, k in ipairs(order) do
        local v = raw[k]
        if v then
            local valid = true
            if ranges[k] then
                c[k] = tonumber(v[1])
                valid = inrange(c[k], ranges[k][1], ranges[k][2])
            elseif allowed[k] then
                c[k] = v[1]
                valid = allowed[k][v[1]] == true
            elseif k == "RANDOM" then
                local seed, p, corrupt = tonumber(v[1]), tonumber(v[2]), tonumber(v[3])
                valid =
                    inrange(seed, 1, 2147483646) and p >= 0 and corrupt >= 0 and p + corrupt <= 100
                c[k] = {seed, p, corrupt}
            else
                local values = {}
                for _, s in ipairs(v) do
                    local number, extra
                    if k == "DELAYDATA" or k == "DELAYCTRL" then
                        local a, b = s:match("^([^:]+):([^:]+)$")
                        number, extra = tonumber(a), tonumber(b)
                        if not inrange(number, 1, 9999) or not inrange(extra, 1, 50) then
                            valid = false
                        end
                    else
                        number = tonumber(s)
                        local lo, hi = 1, 9999
                        if k == "SNAPSHOT" then
                            lo, hi = 0, 2000
                        end
                        if not inrange(number, lo, hi) then
                            valid = false
                        end
                    end
                    if values[number] then
                        valid = false
                    end
                    values[number] = extra or true
                end
                c[k] = values
            end
            if not valid then
                return nil, "bad value for " .. k
            end
        end
    end
    if c.PROTOCOL == "SR" and c.DUPACK then
        return nil, "DUPACK not supported for SR"
    end
    local m = 1 << c.SEQBITS
    local limit = c.PROTOCOL == "SW" and 1 or (c.PROTOCOL == "GBN" and m - 1 or m // 2)
    if c.WINDOW > limit and not (c.UNSAFE == "ON" and c.PROTOCOL ~= "SW") then
        return nil, "window " .. c.WINDOW .. " exceeds limit " .. limit .. " for " .. c.PROTOCOL
    end
    local first
    for i in pairs(c.LOSEDATA) do
        if c.CORRUPTDATA[i] and (not first or i < first) then
            first = i
        end
    end
    if first then
        return nil, "data #" .. first .. " both lost and corrupted"
    end
    for i in pairs(c.LOSECTRL) do
        if c.CORRUPTCTRL[i] and (not first or i < first) then
            first = i
        end
    end
    if first then
        return nil, "control #" .. first .. " both lost and corrupted"
    end
    return c
end
local function decimal(x, y, digits, multiplier)
    local scale = 10 ^ digits
    local v = x * (multiplier or 1) * scale // y
    return string.format("%d.%0" .. digits .. "d", v // scale, v % scale)
end
local function simulate(c)
    local n, w, m, T, d = c.FRAMES, c.WINDOW, 1 << c.SEQBITS, c.TIMEOUT, c.DELAY
    local sr = c.PROTOCOL == "SR"
    local trace = c.TRACE
    local base, H, nextframe, C, D = 0, 0, 0, T, 0
    local r, naksent = 0, false
    local timer, timers, acked, queue, queued, buffer = nil, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local cwnd, threshold, A = 1, w, 0
    local dataEvents, ctrlEvents = {}, {}
    local x = c.RANDOM and c.RANDOM[1]
    local stats = {
        data = 0,
        resent = 0,
        control = 0,
        nak = 0,
        timeouts = 0,
        fastretx = 0,
        lost_data = 0,
        lost_ctrl = 0,
        corrupt_data = 0,
        corrupt_ctrl = 0,
        delivered = 0,
        errors = 0,
        discarded = 0,
        max_buffer = 0
    }
    local records = {}
    for f = 0, n - 1 do
        records[f] = {tx = 0}
    end
    local function line(t, kind, s)
        if kind == "always" or trace == "ALL" or trace == kind then
            emit(t .. " " .. s)
        end
    end
    local function effective()
        return c.CONGESTION == "ON" and math.min(w, cwnd) or w
    end
    local function outcome(kind, number)
        local result = "normal"
        if c.RANDOM then
            x = 48271 * x % 2147483647
            local v = x % 100
            if v < c.RANDOM[2] then
                result = "lost"
            elseif v < c.RANDOM[2] + c.RANDOM[3] then
                result = "corrupt"
            end
        end
        local suffix = kind == "data" and "DATA" or "CTRL"
        if c["LOSE" .. suffix][number] then
            result = "lost"
        end
        if c["CORRUPT" .. suffix][number] then
            result = "corrupt"
        end
        return result
    end
    local function transmit(t, kind, value)
        local number, events, delays
        if kind == "data" then
            number = stats.data
            events = dataEvents
            delays = c.DELAYDATA
        else
            number = stats.control
            events = ctrlEvents
            delays = c.DELAYCTRL
        end
        local arrival = t + d + (delays[number] or 0)
        events[arrival] = events[arrival] or {}
        events[arrival][#events[arrival] + 1] = {
            kind = kind,
            value = value,
            number = number,
            outcome = outcome(kind, number)
        }
    end
    local function control(t, kind, a)
        stats.control = stats.control + 1
        if kind == "nak" then
            stats.nak = stats.nak + 1
        end
        line(t, "RECEIVER", kind:upper() .. " a=" .. a .. " #" .. stats.control)
        transmit(t, kind, a)
    end
    local function deliver(t, payload)
        if payload == r then
            line(t, "RECEIVER", "DELIVER f=" .. r)
            records[r].delivered = t
            stats.delivered = stats.delivered + 1
        else
            line(t, "RECEIVER", "DELIVER f=" .. r .. " wrong=" .. payload)
            stats.errors = stats.errors + 1
        end
        r = r + 1
        naksent = false
    end
    local function discard(t, s)
        stats.discarded = stats.discarded + 1
        line(t, "RECEIVER", "DISCARD seq=" .. s)
    end
    local function enqueue(f)
        if not queued[f] then
            queue[#queue + 1] = f
            queued[f] = true
        end
    end
    local function removequeue(f)
        if queued[f] then
            for i, v in ipairs(queue) do
                if v == f then
                    table.remove(queue, i)
                    break
                end
            end
            queued[f] = nil
        end
    end
    local function goback()
        nextframe, timer, D = base, nil, 0
    end
    local function increase(count)
        if c.CONGESTION ~= "ON" then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            if cwnd < w then
                if cwnd < threshold then
                    cwnd = cwnd + 1
                else
                    A = A + 1
                    if A == cwnd then
                        cwnd, A = cwnd + 1, 0
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function decrease(timeout)
        if c.CONGESTION == "ON" then
            threshold = math.max(cwnd // 2, 1)
            cwnd = timeout and 1 or threshold
            A = 0
        end
    end
    local function showwindow(t, oldc, olds)
        if c.CONGESTION == "ON" and (oldc ~= cwnd or olds ~= threshold) then
            line(t, "SENDER", "CWND " .. cwnd .. " ssthresh=" .. threshold)
        end
    end
    local function receive(t, e)
        local payload = e.value
        local s = payload % m
        line(t, "RECEIVER", "RECV seq=" .. s .. " #" .. e.number)
        if not sr then
            if s == r % m then
                deliver(t, payload)
                control(t, "ack", s)
            else
                discard(t, s)
                if c.NAK == "ON" and not naksent then
                    control(t, "nak", r % m)
                    naksent = true
                elseif r > 0 then
                    control(t, "ack", (r - 1) % m)
                end
            end
        else
            local offset = (s - r) % m
            if offset < w then
                local position = r + offset
                if buffer[position] ~= nil then
                    discard(t, s)
                    control(t, "ack", s)
                elseif offset == 0 then
                    deliver(t, payload)
                    while buffer[r] ~= nil do
                        local value = buffer[r]
                        buffer[r] = nil
                        deliver(t, value)
                    end
                    control(t, "ack", s)
                else
                    buffer[position] = payload
                    local count = 0
                    for _ in pairs(buffer) do
                        count = count + 1
                    end
                    stats.max_buffer = math.max(stats.max_buffer, count)
                    line(t, "RECEIVER", "BUFFER f=" .. position)
                    control(t, "ack", s)
                    if c.NAK == "ON" and not naksent then
                        control(t, "nak", r % m)
                        naksent = true
                    end
                end
            else
                discard(t, s)
                if (r - s) % m <= w then
                    control(t, "ack", s)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function receivecontrol(t, e)
        local oldc, olds, oldbase = cwnd, threshold, base
        local a = e.value
        local f = base + (a - base) % m
        local accept = false
        if e.kind == "ack" then
            if sr then
                if f < H and not acked[f] then
                    accept = true
                    acked[f], timers[f] = true, nil
                    records[f].acked = records[f].acked or t
                    removequeue(f)
                    while base < H and acked[base] do
                        base = base + 1
                    end
                    increase(1)
                end
            elseif f < H then
                accept = true
                base = f + 1
                if nextframe < base then
                    nextframe = base
                end
                increase(base - oldbase)
            end
        else
            if sr then
                if f < H and not acked[f] then
                    accept = true
                    timers[f] = nil
                    enqueue(f)
                end
            elseif f <= H then
                accept = true
                base = f
                increase(base - oldbase)
                goback()
            end
            if accept then
                decrease(false)
            end
        end
        if base > oldbase then
            C = T
            if not sr then
                D = 0
                for j = oldbase, base - 1 do
                    records[j].acked = records[j].acked or t
                end
            end
        end
        if accept then
            if not sr and e.kind == "ack" then
                timer = base ~= nextframe and t + C or nil
            end
            line(
                t,
                "SENDER",
                "GOT" .. e.kind:upper() .. " a=" .. a .. " #" .. e.number .. " base=" .. base
            )
        else
            line(t, "SENDER", "OLD" .. e.kind:upper() .. " a=" .. a .. " #" .. e.number)
            if not sr and e.kind == "ack" and c.DUPACK and base >= 1 and a == (base - 1) % m then
                D = D + 1
                if D == c.DUPACK then
                    stats.fastretx = stats.fastretx + 1
                    line(t, "SENDER", "FASTRETX f=" .. base)
                    goback()
                    decrease(false)
                end
            end
        end
        showwindow(t, oldc, olds)
    end
    local function arrival(t, e, isdata)
        if e.outcome == "normal" then
            if isdata then
                receive(t, e)
            else
                receivecontrol(t, e)
            end
        else
            local suffix = isdata and "data" or "ctrl"
            local key = e.outcome .. "_" .. suffix
            stats[key] = stats[key] + 1
            line(
                t,
                isdata and "RECEIVER" or "SENDER",
                (e.outcome == "lost" and "LOST " or "CORRUPT ") .. e.kind .. " #" .. e.number
            )
        end
    end
    local function timeout(t, f)
        local oldc, olds = cwnd, threshold
        stats.timeouts = stats.timeouts + 1
        line(t, "SENDER", "TIMEOUT f=" .. f)
        if sr then
            timers[f] = nil
            enqueue(f)
        else
            goback()
        end
        if c.BACKOFF == "ON" then
            C = math.min(2 * C, 8 * T)
        end
        decrease(true)
        showwindow(t, oldc, olds)
    end
    local function send(t, f)
        local record = records[f]
        stats.data = stats.data + 1
        local kind = "SEND"
        if record.tx > 0 then
            stats.resent = stats.resent + 1
            kind = "RESEND"
        end
        record.tx = record.tx + 1
        if record.first == nil then
            record.first = t
        end
        line(t, "SENDER", kind .. " f=" .. f .. " seq=" .. f % m .. " #" .. stats.data)
        transmit(t, "data", f)
    end
    local completion, finish
    for t = 0, c.MAXTICKS do
        local arrivals = dataEvents[t] or {}
        table.sort(
            arrivals,
            function(a, b)
                return a.number < b.number
            end
        )
        for _, e in ipairs(arrivals) do
            arrival(t, e, true)
        end
        arrivals = ctrlEvents[t] or {}
        table.sort(
            arrivals,
            function(a, b)
                return a.number < b.number
            end
        )
        for _, e in ipairs(arrivals) do
            arrival(t, e, false)
        end
        if base == n then
            completion = t
        else
            if sr then
                for f = base, H - 1 do
                    if timers[f] == t then
                        timeout(t, f)
                    end
                end
            elseif timer == t then
                timeout(t, base)
            end
            local f
            if sr then
                if #queue > 0 then
                    f = table.remove(queue, 1)
                    queued[f] = nil
                elseif H < n and H < base + effective() and H * c.INTERVAL <= t then
                    f = H
                    H = H + 1
                end
                if f ~= nil then
                    send(t, f)
                    timers[f] = t + C
                end
            elseif
                nextframe < n and nextframe < base + effective() and
                    (nextframe < H or nextframe * c.INTERVAL <= t)
             then
                f = nextframe
                send(t, f)
                H = math.max(H, f + 1)
                nextframe = nextframe + 1
                if timer == nil then
                    timer = t + C
                end
            end
        end
        if c.SNAPSHOT[t] then
            local sender, receiver = {}, {}
            for f = 0, n - 1 do
                local state
                if (sr and acked[f]) or (not sr and f < base) then
                    state = "A"
                elseif (sr and queued[f]) or (not sr and nextframe <= f and f < H) then
                    state = "R"
                elseif (sr and f < H) or (not sr and f < nextframe) then
                    state = "O"
                elseif f < base + effective() then
                    state = "W"
                else
                    state = "."
                end
                sender[#sender + 1] = state
                if f < r then
                    state = "D"
                elseif sr and buffer[f] ~= nil then
                    state = "B"
                elseif (sr and f < r + w) or (not sr and f == r) then
                    state = "W"
                else
                    state = "."
                end
                receiver[#receiver + 1] = state
            end
            line(
                t,
                "always",
                "SNAPSHOT sender=" .. table.concat(sender) .. " receiver=" .. table.concat(receiver)
            )
        end
        if completion or t == c.MAXTICKS then
            finish = t
            line(t, "always", completion and "DONE" or "ABORT")
            break
        end
    end
    local latency = 0
    for f = 0, n - 1 do
        local rec = records[f]
        local function stamp(v)
            return v == nil and "-" or tostring(v)
        end
        emit(
            "frame " ..
                f ..
                    ": seq=" ..
                        f % m ..
                            " tx=" ..
                                rec.tx ..
                                    " first=" ..
                                        stamp(rec.first) ..
                                            " delivered=" ..
                                                stamp(rec.delivered) ..
                                                    " acked=" .. stamp(rec.acked)
        )
        if rec.delivered then
            latency = latency + rec.delivered - rec.first
        end
    end
    emit(
        "totals: data=" ..
            stats.data ..
                " resent=" ..
                    stats.resent ..
                        " control=" ..
                            stats.control ..
                                " nak=" ..
                                    stats.nak ..
                                        " timeouts=" ..
                                            stats.timeouts .. " fastretx=" .. stats.fastretx
    )
    emit(
        "channel: lost_data=" ..
            stats.lost_data ..
                " lost_ctrl=" ..
                    stats.lost_ctrl ..
                        " corrupt_data=" ..
                            stats.corrupt_data .. " corrupt_ctrl=" .. stats.corrupt_ctrl
    )
    emit(
        "receiver: delivered=" ..
            stats.delivered ..
                " errors=" ..
                    stats.errors ..
                        " discarded=" .. stats.discarded .. " max_buffer=" .. stats.max_buffer
    )
    local goodput = completion and decimal(stats.delivered, completion, 2) or "-"
    local efficiency = decimal(stats.delivered, stats.data, 1, 100)
    emit(
        "result: completion=" ..
            (completion or "-") ..
                " goodput=" ..
                    goodput ..
                        " efficiency=" ..
                            efficiency ..
                                "% utilization=" ..
                                    decimal(stats.data, finish + 1, 1, 100) ..
                                        "% latency=" ..
                                            (stats.delivered > 0 and
                                                decimal(latency, stats.delivered, 2) or
                                                "-")
    )
    return {
        completion = completion,
        delivered = stats.delivered,
        data = stats.data,
        goodput = goodput,
        efficiency = efficiency
    }
end
local results = {}
local q = tonumber(io.read())
for i = 1, q do
    local name = words(io.read())[2]
    local lines = {}
    while true do
        local line = io.read()
        if line == "END" then
            break
        end
        lines[#lines + 1] = line
    end
    emit("== " .. name .. " ==")
    local c, err = validate(lines)
    local result
    if err then
        emit("error: " .. err)
        result = {invalid = true}
    else
        emit(
            "config: " ..
                c.PROTOCOL ..
                    " n=" ..
                        c.FRAMES ..
                            " w=" ..
                                c.WINDOW ..
                                    " k=" .. c.SEQBITS .. " T=" .. c.TIMEOUT .. " d=" .. c.DELAY
        )
        emit(
            "options: interval=" ..
                c.INTERVAL ..
                    " limit=" ..
                        c.MAXTICKS ..
                            " dupack=" ..
                                (c.DUPACK or "off") ..
                                    " nak=" ..
                                        c.NAK:lower() ..
                                            " backoff=" ..
                                                c.BACKOFF:lower() ..
                                                    " congestion=" ..
                                                        c.CONGESTION:lower() ..
                                                            " unsafe=" ..
                                                                c.UNSAFE:lower() ..
                                                                    " trace=" ..
                                                                        c.TRACE:lower() ..
                                                                            " random=" ..
                                                                                (c.RANDOM and
                                                                                    table.concat(
                                                                                        c.RANDOM,
                                                                                        "/"
                                                                                    ) or
                                                                                    "off")
        )
        result = simulate(c)
        result.protocol = c.PROTOCOL
    end
    result.name, result.order = name, i
    results[#results + 1] = result
end
emit("== ranking ==")
local completed = {}
for _, r in ipairs(results) do
    if r.completion then
        completed[#completed + 1] = r
    end
end
table.sort(
    completed,
    function(a, b)
        local left, right = a.delivered * b.completion, b.delivered * a.completion
        if left ~= right then
            return left > right
        end
        left, right = a.delivered * b.data, b.delivered * a.data
        if left ~= right then
            return left > right
        end
        return a.order < b.order
    end
)
for rank, r in ipairs(completed) do
    emit(
        rank ..
            ". " ..
                r.name ..
                    " " ..
                        r.protocol ..
                            " goodput=" .. r.goodput .. " efficiency=" .. r.efficiency .. "%"
    )
end
for _, r in ipairs(results) do
    if not r.completion then
        emit("- " .. r.name .. " " .. (r.invalid and "invalid" or "aborted"))
    end
end
emit("== protocols ==")
for _, protocol in ipairs({"SW", "GBN", "SR"}) do
    local count, delivered, ticks, data = 0, 0, 0, 0
    for _, r in ipairs(completed) do
        if r.protocol == protocol then
            count = count + 1
            delivered = delivered + r.delivered
            ticks = ticks + r.completion
            data = data + r.data
        end
    end
    if count > 0 then
        emit(
            protocol ..
                ": runs=" ..
                    count ..
                        " goodput=" ..
                            decimal(delivered, ticks, 2) ..
                                " efficiency=" .. decimal(delivered, data, 1, 100) .. "%"
        )
    end
end
